summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The fundX Future Fund Opportunities ETF (FFOX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund seeks to provide capital appreciation through an actively managed portfolio of small- and mid-cap  companies from around the world. The funds investments focus on long-term megatrends believed to be best positioned for outperformance. FFOX was launched on Jun 10, 2025 and is issued by FundX.

holdings.infoBox: FFOX is an equity ETF with a total of 67 individual holdings. The top holdings are First American Government Obligs X stock at 6.85%, Natera at 3.15%, Guardant Health at 2.87%, Halozyme Therapeutics at 2.39%, and Ligand Pharmaceuticals at 2.02%.
